name: @contracts/source
description: Shared DTOs and SSE event types for opencode-chat. Consumed via the '@contracts/*' TypeScript path alias — never imported through node_modules. apps/web (esbuild) resolves the alias straight to src/*.ts. apps/api (plain tsc + tsc-alias, no tsconfig-paths shim at runtime) resolves the alias to this package's own compiled dist/*.d.ts + dist/*.js, so building the api never has to pull this package's .ts source into the api's own tsc rootDir — run `npm run build` here first.
